source: Mills (2004) Solar Energy 76; Novatec Solar / Häberle et al. (2002) Eurosun; Zhu et al. (2014) Solar Energy 103; Forristall (2003) NREL/TP-550-34169; Incropera (2011) Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer

unit.name: Compact Linear Fresnel Reflector (CLFR) — Novatec/Solarmundo-class, DSG receiver
unit.note: Reuses optical/receiver parameters from EC056 F1b (Häberle 2002 Solarmundo-type). F2 upgrade adds a lumped receiver-wall energy-balance ODE coupled to HTF/steam enthalpy.

total_mirror_width.note: Sum of all parallel flat mirror-row widths (aperture width). Mills (2004) CLFR rows.

focal_length.note: Height of elevated linear receiver above mirror field

D_abs_inner.note: Absorber tube inner diameter (HTF flow bore)

intercept_factor.note: Fraction of reflected DNI intercepted by receiver

b_T.note: Transversal IAM polynomial coeff: IAM_T = 1 - b_T*theta_T^2

h_conv_cavity.note: Cavity convective loss coefficient (receiver wall to ambient)

h_htf.note: Internal convective coefficient, receiver wall to HTF/steam (forced convection in tube)

m_wall_per_m.note: Receiver-tube + selective-coating thermal mass per metre

mdot_htf.note: Design HTF mass flow through receiver

cp_htf.note: Effective HTF/feedwater specific heat (thermal-oil / pressurised-water surrogate)

eta_powerblock.note: Rankine power-block conversion efficiency (optional electric output)
